# Zohar Babin

> CSO at Kaltura, Inc. (NASDAQ: KLTR), the Agentic DX Platform. Chief
> Troublemaker everywhere else. Dreaming, Building, Breaking, & Shipping
> agentic AI, research, and personal fintech. Advises founders, boards,
> and investment committees; occasionally invests in early-stage startups.

Zohar has been at Kaltura for ~20 years, helping grow it from an
open-source disruptor into a market-leading public company in Agentic AI.
He leads strategy, partnerships, and M&A as Chief Strategy & Corporate
Development Officer (CSO), and previously served as the company's Data
Protection Officer, directing cybersecurity, privacy, and platform
operations. He has been building and advocating open source since he was
13 — agentic AI is the current chapter of a much longer habit, not a new
side project. He's enthusiastic about agentic AI harnessed for good — for
education, health, art, honest discourse, and open collaboration. His
recent open-source work and writing spans agentic AI systems, AI-powered
M&A due diligence, enterprise AI governance, verification-first tools
that trace and explain AI, and AI tools for personal finance. Known as
"Chief Troublemaker" — happiest breaking things to build them better —
his special power is turning chaotic, cross-disciplinary problems into
shipped products. He brings that skill to advising founders, boards, and
investment committees in AI, media, and developer platforms, and to
occasional early-stage startup investing. Ships under the GitHub handle
zoharbabin.

Kaltura's official team page and Zohar's LinkedIn profile are authoritative
for his current title.

## Projects

Featured:

- Web Researcher MCP — https://zoharbabin.com/web-researcher-mcp/
  MCP-compatible research assistant: web search (14 providers), academic,
  patent and SEC filing search, content extraction, and multi-source deep
  research, cited to original sources. Written in Go, with Python bindings. Install via Docker,
  Homebrew, Scoop, winget or uvx. 40k+ downloads (PyPI, Docker, releases),
  80+ releases, 63 GitHub stars.
- Due Diligence Agents — https://zoharbabin.com/due-diligence-agents/
  Forensic M&A due diligence powered by 13 specialized AI agents across 9
  domains, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK. Citation-verified, not RAG:
  every finding traced to an exact page and quote. Runs on the Anthropic API,
  AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or an Anthropic-compatible gateway. 10k+
  downloads (PyPI, Docker), 112 GitHub stars, 26 forks.

More:

- Kaltura Intelligent Agents SDK — https://kaltura.github.io/intelligent-agents-sdk/
  Zero-dependency JavaScript SDK for conversational AI avatar agents: provision,
  configure, measure, and run them live in any web page. MIT.
- Enterprise AI Agents Spec — https://zoharbabin.com/enterprise-ai-agents-spec/
  Open blueprint for scalable enterprise AI agent swarms: governance,
  compliance, architecture patterns.
- WebRTC Inspector — https://github.com/zoharbabin/webrtc-inspector
  Debug and fault-test WebRTC sessions. Chrome extension, MCP server for AI
  coding agents, npm library and Playwright plugin.
- Claude Code Timestamps — https://github.com/zoharbabin/claude-code-message-timestamps
  Show local time on every Claude Code message. Zero-config, cross-OS.
- Brand Voice — https://github.com/zoharbabin/brand-voice
  Enforce brand writing guidelines in Claude Code: PostToolUse hook, MCP server, CLI.
- EDGAR Analytics — https://github.com/zoharbabin/edgar_analytics
  Python library to extract, analyze and forecast SEC EDGAR filings. 11k+ PyPI
  downloads.
- Fen — https://fen.md/
  Native Swift/SwiftUI Markdown editor for macOS and iOS. Local-first, no telemetry.

Across all projects: 63,000+ downloads (PyPI, Docker, npm, GitHub releases),
485+ GitHub stars across 48 public repos, 130+ tagged releases,
450+ merged PRs across open-source projects (including Microsoft winget-pkgs).

Earlier work: Telegram Monitor, Company Recon Skill, GitHub Org Stats,
AI Chat Chronicles, Karaokify (all on https://github.com/zoharbabin).
